name: brigade-stress
description: M7 red-team: a genuine target with organic honest followers, brigaded by a 200-account tightly-connected reporting cohort (dense internal follows, like a sybil ring — trust-and-reach §4's threat model A4). Measured 2026-08-24 (seed 11): the brigade collapses into a single connected cluster of all 200 members, so mass is just the strongest single member's weight (3.53) instead of 200 summed weights; p_auto = 0.176 (report_impact x mass), nowhere near the 0.6 cap; target standing = 0.824 — diversity weighting is doing its job. The same 200 reports from unconnected accounts would slam the cap instead (see diverse-reports.json, where 5 reporters alone reach it).
